entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 bch_be returns zero for synthetic German-speaking Community rows coded drgn1=4; the BE.xml child-benefit policy has drgn1 branches only for Brussels (1), Flanders (2), and Wallonia (3), which all match exactly in the same suite. The source-backed RuleSpec pays the DG decree amounts: Article 8 base of 157 EUR/month plus the Article 117 paragraph 4 annual supplement of 62.55 EUR for 2025 under the 2025-2027 index freeze. Verified deterministic (2026-07-05 batch- size-1 audit): the DG zero persists at --comparison-batch-size 1 and is byte-stable across ten identical DG households in one run (all 0.0), while the Brussels control pays bch_s=2262.99 in isolation — so this is a genuine regional coverage gap, not batch-position contamination.
